About Whispering Hills

Al and Michelle Anderson bought the land for Whispering Hills in 1990.

Al already ran a growing landscaping company. Together the couple built the garden center and landscape business you see on Route 31 today. From the start they chose the best materials and made a point of following up with their customers.

Common questions

Where are you and when are you open?

We're at 8109 S Illinois Rte 31, Crystal Lake, IL 60014. We're open Monday to Friday 7AM to 4PM and Saturday 7AM to 2PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Where do you deliver, and what does it cost?

Call 847-658-5610 for delivery areas and fees.

Is there a minimum for bulk delivery?

Yes. Each delivery order needs a minimum of 2 yards of material.

Can I get two kinds of mulch on one truck?

No. Our dump trucks do not divide different types of material. If you need two materials, place two separate orders of at least 2 yards each.

Which materials do I order by phone?

Call 847-658-5610 to order pulverized topsoil or garden mix, mushroom compost and fill dirt.

Do you design landscapes?

Yes. Bring in photos of the area you'd like to spruce up and our staff can draw a rough design. For full-scale designs we work with a certified landscape architect who creates professional drawings. To-scale plans and installation supervision are available at an hourly rate.

What warranty comes with a new patio?

Our hardscaping work is backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty and a lifetime limited warranty on paving material. We're an Authorized Unilock Contractor, and our hardscaping staff is fully bonded and insured.

Do you guarantee your plants?

Nursery stock we furnish and install is guaranteed to grow for one year. If a plant fails to survive, we issue one replacement equal to 100% of the original price paid.

Nursery stock you plant yourself is guaranteed for one year from the date of purchase, for a replacement value of 50% of the original price paid. That comes as store credit for plant material.

Plants are replaced only when they are 100% dead. Annuals, perennials, groundcovers, roses, azaleas, rhododendron and vines are not guaranteed, and plants bought at a discount of 50% or more carry no guarantee. Read the full return and guarantee policy.
